facts.text: Melanie expressed admiration for Caroline's artwork and acknowledged its role in self-acceptance and self-discovery.

evidence.quote: Wow, Caroline, that's so cool! Art can be so healing and a way to really connect with who you are. It's awesome that beauty can be found in the imperfections.
Wow, Caroline, that's gorgeous! I love the self-acceptance and love theme.

facts.text: Caroline shared that art has helped her explore her transition and changing body, and has been a way to work through personal challenges.

evidence.quote: Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that art teaches her to accept the beauty of imperfections.

evidence.quote: I love that it teaches me to accept the beauty of imperfections.
